case.summary: An investigation was triggered by a bank model risk score of 0.55 on the flagged transaction. The decisive evidence is that the customer confirmed they made the transaction, and the amount of $30.91 along with product W sat within the customer's normal range of $15 to $226. It was assumed the customer would confirm the transaction because no graph evidence beyond the alert pointed to fraud and similar profiles were cleared after cardholder confirmation. Per Fraud Policy R3, because the customer confirmed the transaction, the case is concluded as legitimate with a verdict of no fraud, and the transaction is allowed.
